info.name: AINP-NF API
info.description:
REST API for the AINP-Natural Farming Project Management System (ICAR-IIFSR).

**Generated file: do not edit by hand.** Run `npm run postman` in icar-nf-backend after changing routes or DTOs.

### Getting started
1. Set the `loginEmail` and `loginPassword` collection variables (for example, the seeded Super Administrator from `.env`).
2. Run **Auth → Sign in**. The API returns an httpOnly `nf_session` cookie; Postman stores it and sends it with every later request automatically.
3. **Create** requests save the new record's id in a variable (e.g. `centreId`), which **Get** and **Update** requests then use.

### Conventions
- Success: `{ "success": true, "data": …, "meta"? }`. Failure: `{ "success": false, "error": { "code", "message", "details"?, "requestId" } }`.
- Every response has an `X-Request-Id` header; quote it when reporting a problem so it can be found in the server logs.
- Each request's description lists who may call it and every field with its validation rules.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Sign in and out. The session is an httpOnly cookie that Postman stores and resends.

request.description:
Checks the email and password and sets the httpOnly session cookie. Returns the session: user, role, capabilities and `mustChangePassword`. Limited to 10 failed attempts per 15 minutes per IP.

**Access:** public (no sign-in needed)

**Endpoint:** `POST /api/v1/auth/login`

**Body**

| Field | Type | Required | Rules | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `email` | string | yes | email; pattern `^(?:[A-Za-z0-9_'+\-]+\.)*[A-Za-z0-9_'+\-]*[A-Za-z0-9_+-]@(?:[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9\-]*\.)+[A-Za-z]{2,}$` |  |
| `password` | string | yes | 1–128 chars |  |

Unknown fields are rejected.

Clears the session cookie. Returns 204.

**Access:** public (no sign-in needed)

**Endpoint:** `POST /api/v1/auth/logout`

Returns the signed-in user with their role, capabilities and the roles they can manage.

**Access:** any signed-in user

**Endpoint:** `GET /api/v1/auth/me`

Changes your own password. Required after first sign-in with a temporary password: until then every other endpoint returns 403 `PASSWORD_CHANGE_REQUIRED`. Ends all other sessions.

**Access:** any signed-in user

**Endpoint:** `POST /api/v1/auth/change-password`

**Body**

| Field | Type | Required | Rules | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `currentPassword` | string | yes | 1–128 chars |  |
| `newPassword` | string | yes | 10–128 chars | At least 10 characters with a letter and a digit |

Unknown fields are rejected.

request.description:
Creates an account with a temporary password the person must change at first sign-in. For a Centre PI, prefer **Centres → Assign Centre PI**, which also handles replacing the current PI.

**Access:** signed in, and the role needs `users.manage`

**Endpoint:** `POST /api/v1/users`

**Body**

| Field | Type | Required | Rules | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | string | yes | one of `Dr`, `Prof`, `Mr`, `Mrs`, `Ms` |  |
| `firstName` | string | yes | 1–60 chars; pattern `^[\p{L}][\p{L}\p{M}.' -]*$` |  |
| `middleName` | string | no | 1–60 chars; pattern `^[\p{L}][\p{L}\p{M}.' -]*$` |  |
| `surname` | string | no | 1–60 chars; pattern `^[\p{L}][\p{L}\p{M}.' -]*$` | Leave empty if the person has no surname |
| `designation` | string | yes | 2–120 chars |  |
| `email` | string | yes | email; pattern `^(?:[A-Za-z0-9_'+\-]+\.)*[A-Za-z0-9_'+\-]*[A-Za-z0-9_+-]@(?:[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9\-]*\.)+[A-Za-z]{2,}$` |  |
| `mobile` | string | yes | pattern `^(?:\+91[\s-]?|0)?[6-9]\d{4}[\s-]?\d{5}$` |  |
| `organization` | string | yes | 2–200 chars | Organization name |
| `temporaryPassword` | string | yes | 10–128 chars | Temporary password you share with the person. They must change it at first sign-in. At least 10 characters with a letter and a digit. |
| `roleId` | string | yes | one of `superadmin`, `pc`, `pi` |  |
| `centreId` | string | no | ObjectId; default `null`; nullable | Required for Centre PI; ignored for national roles |

Unknown fields are rejected.
